hub.title: Viber
hub.intro: Connect a Viber Public Account (Bot). Inbound lands in your shared Team Inbox and replies, keyword rules and auto-responders work exactly like every other channel — we register the webhook for you automatically.

hub.how1: Create a Viber Public Account (Bot) at partners.viber.com (or the Viber Admin Panel).
hub.how2: Open your bot → Edit info → copy the authentication token.
hub.how3: Paste it here and Connect — we validate it and register the webhook automatically.
hub.know1: The webhook needs a public HTTPS domain with a valid CA certificate — a local or IP address is rejected by Viber.
hub.know2: You can only message a user AFTER they open a chat with your account (subscribe). Until then, a send returns “user not subscribed”.
hub.know3: There is no 24/48-hour window — once a user has subscribed you can reply anytime.
hub.know4: Broadcasts send to up to 300 subscribed users per batch.
hub.know5: The token is encrypted at rest and never shown to the browser again.
